tweets.text:
It was my honor to attend the signing of the National Angel Family Day Proclamation today at the White House. I was humbled to be in the presence of the families who tragically lost their loved ones to illegal alien killers. Although heart-shattered, they maintain their resolve to support President Trump in fighting for justice and solutions to these completely preventable crimes enabled by the reckless Biden Administration. 

I and President Trump have been deeply engaged with angel families for over a decade, and we will always stand with them. 

They have my utmost respect and support… and shame on anyone who gets in this Administration’s way of removing public safety risks—who have no right to be here—from our great country.
@WhiteHouse 

https://t.co/BAI9EshiSu
